notes: The Chapel tab now works step by step, like a Google Form: preparation first, then cleaning, then closing.
new: Chapel is now three steps: Today's preparation, Cleaning and Closing, shown one at a time so there is much less scrolling.
You can only go to the next step after every item in the current step is ticked. If you tap Next too early, the app shows how many items are left.
A step bar at the top shows your progress, with a check mark on finished steps.
The app opens the Chapel tab on the first step you have not finished yet.
Supplies has its own button next to the Chapel title.
changed: Preparation and the daily, weekly and monthly schedule are merged into Today's preparation. The schedule is a collapsed section at the bottom of that step.
The old shortcut buttons (Cleaning, Preparation, Closing, Supplies, Schedule) are removed.
The Pocket Prayer Book, Last 7 days, Daily reminder and Offline status now sit on the Supplies page.
The Hide done button is removed, because finished items stay visible inside each step.
Search now opens the correct step for the task you pick.
